lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. The dataset contains approximately 1.3 million buildings with geometry and attributes, representing an estimated 12% of total buildings in Argentina based on AI-mapped estimates. Data quality varies with an average age of 4 years and 12% of features updated within the last 6 months.
